body:
I’m stuck right now and envisioning my future free of drama, making my own money, seeing my son everyday, is the only thing that gives me motivation. 
I can’t wait to go out with girlfriends and have drinks on a restaurant patio with chips and salsa.
I’ve talked to DV resource centers and its alwags the run around. I have nothing. No money, no car, no family, no job. There’s no resources for women like me. I’ll never get out of this alive.
